train.letKvasirPlanDesc: Answer five questions and you are set

me.title: Me
me.privateProfileDesc: Only share aggregate numbers with the hall
me.passwordDesc: A passkey is the easiest way in. A password is the alternative when Face ID can't be used.
me.passwordSaved: Password saved. You've been signed out on your other devices.
me.passkeysDesc: Face ID and Touch ID. You can have several — one per device.
me.passkeyNameHint: e.g. “iPhone” or “work Mac”. So you know which one you're removing.
me.passkeyRemoved: The key is gone. You've been signed out on your other devices.
me.passkeyReauth: Confirm with your password to remove the key.
me.passkeyReauthKey: Confirm with one of your passkeys to remove the key.
me.passkeyLastWayIn: That's your only way in. Set a password first — or have a mail server configured, so a sign-in link can reach you.
me.passkeyFreshLogin: Couldn't confirm with a key. Sign in again with an e-mail link and remove it right after — a fresh sign-in counts as proof.
me.passkeyRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
me.rotationUnsupported: Your browser can't lock rotation. On an iPhone it's in Control Centre — swipe down from the top-right and tap the padlock with the arrow around it.
me.supportBody: Uruz is free software under the AGPL. There is no paid tier and nothing is held back. If it saved you an afternoon, you can buy the person who builds it a coffee — entirely optional, and nothing in the app changes either way.

auth.firstRunDesc: You are the first — create the administrator account.
auth.magicSent: Check your inbox — we sent you a sign-in link.
auth.inviteTitle: You are invited to the hall
auth.inviteDesc: Create your access with a passkey (Face ID / Touch ID).
auth.inviteInvalid: The invitation is invalid or has expired.
auth.passkeyCancelled: Passkey was cancelled. Try again, or continue without one.
auth.passkeyDomainError: The browser refused the passkey — the domain in the app's settings doesn't match the address you're on.
auth.passkeyCanSkip: You are already signed in. It's safe to press Continue and add a passkey later under Me.
auth.resetSent: Check your inbox — we've sent a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetDesc: The link works once, for 30 minutes.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
auth.passwordTooCommon: That password is too common — pick another.
auth.passwordTooSimple: The password is too repetitive — use more different characters.
auth.passwordRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
auth.linkExpired: The link has been used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.hallNameHint: Can be changed later. A gym's name, or your own.

coach.title: Kvasir
coach.name: Kvasir
coach.askPlaceholder: e.g. I only have 25 min today, what should I do?
coach.disclaimer: Kvasir gives training suggestions, not medical advice. See a doctor for injuries or persistent pain.
coach.adaptDesc: Tell Kvasir about an ailment or a wish — he'll adjust the workout.
coach.adaptPlaceholder: e.g. my shoulder hurts when I press, or: I'd like more back work
coach.adaptRememberHint: Kvasir will take it into account in all future suggestions.
coach.adaptMedical: If it persists, see a doctor or physiotherapist. Kvasir is not a doctor.
coach.constraintsEmpty: None recorded. Tell Kvasir if something hurts, or what you'd like.
coach.constraintPlaceholder: e.g. bad shoulder, or: want to train back more
coach.programSubtitle: Five questions and you have a plan
coach.programGoalHint: In your own words — or leave it empty.
coach.programMinutes: How long have you got each time?
coach.programEquipmentHint: Leave empty if you train in an ordinary gym.
coach.programConstraintsNote: Kvasir takes the injuries and wishes from your coach page into account.

admin.title: Administration
admin.inviteLinkHint: Copy the link if the email doesn't arrive.
admin.deleteUserWarn: This permanently deletes the member and their entire training history. It cannot be undone.
admin.webauthnMismatch: The passkey domain doesn't match the address — Face ID will fail.
admin.webauthnInsecure: The address is not HTTPS — passkeys will not work.
admin.webauthnBadUrl: The address is not a valid URL.
admin.webauthnOverridden: The server's passkey domain was unusable and has been ignored. Clear the field to avoid confusion.
admin.webauthnInferred: The address is inferred from the request, not set in configuration. That works — set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to pin it.

install.title: Add Uruz to your home screen
iphone: Open the app in Safari (only Safari can install on iOS).
Tap the Share icon (square with an up arrow) in the bottom bar.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap “Add” in the top right. Uruz is now on your home screen.
desktop: Open the app in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon in the address bar, or menu → “Install Uruz”.
Pin the app to the Dock (Mac) or taskbar (Windows).
